title: Doji
caption:
What does a candle with no body mean?

That's a doji. Price moved around but closed almost exactly where it opened. A tie between buyers and sellers.

After a strong run, it can mean momentum is fading. In a sideways range, it means very little. Either way, the next candle shows who won.
